purpose: Complete the first-ten canonical slice, stable ID closure, server-state closure, Step 2 dependency closure and all active lower mirrors without implementing Step 2.

acceptance.requirement: 1-10F is the first unbounded-tower district and Floor 10 continues to Floor 11; Floor 100 remains a milestone.
The four deterministic N/R core characters cover frontline, anti-air, healing and backline disruption; higher rarity is optional acceleration/variation.
Tap damage is zero; auto battle and offline progress are foundational; collect-all, refill tapping and individual collection are not mandatory.
Shop and delivery remain combat support rather than a company-management protagonist loop.
Character/weapon gacha, first-day guarantees, first-copy functionality and mastery/overflow are represented without fixing unvalidated rates.
Every persistent entity uses a registered stable ID or a declared read-only migration alias; display names are not IDs.
S01-S12 normal, loading, pending, failure, retry, reload, multi-tab, refund, revocation and restore responsibilities are closed.
Draw, payment, ad, login, reset, evolution, mastery/exchange, account link and deletion have idempotent server-authoritative transitions.
STEP2_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE defines all fields, enums, IDs, units, invariants, fixtures, migrations, validator requirements and output evidence needed for implementation without guessing.
Old V1 candidate/schema/validator/workflows remain unchanged, non-executable and non-promotable.
No runtime, asset, backend, payment, ad-network, PR or Production operation occurs.
Route-specific critic and checkpoint judge leave unresolved P0/P1 at zero before PASS.
